_notes: Katahdin (Baxter State Park, ME). Geometry from OpenStreetMap (ODbL); run build_backcountry.py after editing.
No avalanche center forecasts Katahdin, so every line here is permanently 'no avalanche forecast — conditions score only'.
Listing a line is not a recommendation to ski it.

zone.name: Katahdin
zone.no_forecast_note: No avalanche center forecasts Katahdin. Baxter State Park requires winter registration and has its own rules for technical terrain.

area_hazards.Chimney Pond: Remote, high alpine terrain with a very long winter approach. Steep couloirs, avalanche terrain, ice and cornices; rescue can take a day or more. Baxter State Park winter registration required.
